metric: masking F2: character-level, label-agnostic, spans merged per text when they overlap or touch, pooled over the task's texts (micro), beta = 2; ranking by F2 per task and Avg F2 per leaderboard
subset: sentences (data/test_sentences.jsonl), the subset every leaderboard row is scored on
native_run: not run: the scorer (src/piimb/metrics.py) and the sampled tasks (data/test_sentences.jsonl) exist only in the Hugging Face repository above, which this workspace cannot download; the samples (5,000 random documents per task, no published seed) cannot be rebuilt from the local files

indication_not_native.what: PIIMB's masking metric re-implemented from its published definition, on the local file: other samples, whole documents instead of PIIMB's sentences. Not comparable with the leaderboard; it says where Harpo stands, not its PIIMB score.
